name: haushaltsbuch
description: Lokales Haushaltsbuch mit Deckungsprüfung, Umbuchungs- und Abo-Erkennung

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
